reach.title: Where can I reach?
reach.subtitle: The forecast below is aimed at {{place}}.
reach.answer: {{band}} reaches {{place}} at {{hour}} UTC — about {{percent}} chance of contact.
reach.mapLoading: Working out where this band reaches
reach.mapUnavailable: The coverage map could not be loaded.
reach.reachLine: {{band}} reaches about {{percent}} of the world at this hour.

window.label: Usable window
window.explain: Above {{ceiling}} the signal passes through the ionosphere into space. Below {{floor}} it is absorbed on the way up. Those two are the MUF and the LUF.
window.explainNoFloor: Above {{ceiling}} the signal passes through the ionosphere into space — that is the MUF. No frequency was reliable enough this hour to set a floor.

grid.footnoteHours: Hours are UTC. Local time at {{place}} is on the clock above.
grid.footnoteSaved: This is saved data, so it cannot show anything that changed since it was fetched.

sections.allBandsHint: How far each band gets you, hour by hour.

spaceWeather.kpSaved: Last reading. A storm since then would be invisible
spaceWeather.unavailable: Live readings are unavailable, so this forecast uses typical conditions for the month.
spaceWeather.measured: Sounder at {{station}}, {{distance}} away, measured foF2 {{value}} at {{time}} UTC.

qualityLegend.footnote: More contrast against the page means a more reliable band. The four states are ordered by lightness, so they still read in greyscale and with any form of colour blindness.

location.title: Choose a path
location.permissionDenied: Location permission was declined. Search for a place instead.
location.unavailable: Your location could not be read. Search for a place instead.

status.errorBody: The prediction service could not be reached. Start it with "pnpm start" in the server directory.

disclaimer.climatology: Monthly climatology, not a live forecast. Assumes smoothed sunspot number {{ssn}} and quiet geomagnetic conditions.
disclaimer.forecast: Monthly climatology using a predicted sunspot number of {{ssn}}. Forecasts further ahead are less certain.
disclaimer.nowcast: Driven by current readings, with an effective sunspot number of {{ssn}}. This estimates the ionosphere, not this path.
disclaimer.station: Assumes 100 W into a dipole 10 m up. A better antenna beats these numbers; a compromise antenna will not reach them.

a11y.swapEnds: Swap the two ends of the path
a11y.windowRail: Usable window: floor {{floor}}, ceiling {{ceiling}}. Tap for an explanation.
a11y.nvis: Reaches by near-vertical incidence, so there is no skip zone.
a11y.sounding: Measured foF2 {{value}} from the sounder at {{station}}, {{distance}} away, at {{time}} UTC. This is a real measurement, not part of the forecast.
a11y.coverage: Coverage map. {{band}} reaches about {{percent}} percent of the world at this hour.
